title: The first-person perspective is a naturally evolved representational format

statements.text: The first-person perspective can be naturalized, because it is a naturally evolved epistemic modality, a specific representational format for presenting knowledge and information in the brain of a conscious organism. Understanding it requires understanding the phenomenal self, beginning with its minimal form.

sources.quote: I believe that the 1PP can be naturalized, because it is a naturally evolved epistemic modality
